name: Paracetamol (Dolo 650, Crocin)
commonUses: Used to treat mild to moderate pain (headaches, body aches, muscle pain) and reduce fever.
sideEffects: Rare side effects when taken at normal doses.
precautions: Do not exceed the daily dose of 4000 mg (4 grams) to prevent liver damage. Keep 4-6 hours gap between doses.
warnings: Avoid taking other paracetamol-containing medications simultaneously. Extreme overdose can cause liver failure.
source: National Health Portal India & Clinical Guidelines
